summary: Frontend-only verification of Goorin Intl Shipments redesign: priority strip (attention + KPI tiles) on Shipments tab and new Open Orders (PO planner) tab. All major test flows PASS. No console/page errors detected.
verified_flows: Login via empty form succeeds (mocked auth) and sidebar 'Intl Shipments' navigates to page.
is-priority-strip renders with 1 'Needs attention' row is-attn-IS-0011 (SASAtrend / Hangzhou Headwear / 'Awaiting prepayment').
KPI card shows 3 tiles (is-kpi-all, is-kpi-released, Units moving). Clicking is-kpi-released filters pipeline to 1 released shipment and adds 'on' class; second click clears filter.
Clicking is-attn-IS-0011 opens IS-0011 detail view.
is-tab-orders renders is-open-orders with filter bar: is-oo-search, is-oo-customer, is-oo-factory, is-oo-window input, is-oo-rec-toggle, is-oo-expand-all, is-oo-groups-toggle all present.
Table shows all 8 expected POs: P0159, P0162, P0164, P0166, P0171, P0173, P0178, P0181.
Row expand shows is-oo-lines-P0159 with SKU/Product/Ordered/Allocated/Shipped/Remaining and totals row.
Expand-all toggles to 'Collapse all' and expands all lines; collapses on second click.
Sort by customer asc → first row 'Buckle Inc., The'; desc → 'SASAtrend'. Sort-units toggles direction.
Search 'Owear' filters to 2 rows. Customer=Owear filter → 2 rows. Factory=Tan Son Apparel (Vietnam) → 1 row.
Groups toggle expands 'Recommended order groups' band showing groups with is-oo-group-0 and 'Create grouped shipment' button (is-oo-group-create-0).
Window days=3 reduces group count vs default 14. Recommended toggle filters table to only grouped POs and highlights.
is-order-create-P0159 opens New Shipment modal prefilled: customer 'Grupo Gardea SA DE CV', factory 'ASI Global Limited (China)', SO S015625, PO P0159, ship 06-10-2026.
is-oo-group-create-0 opens modal with combined SOs/POs prefill.
No console errors and no layout overlap observed at 1920x800.
critical_code_review_comments: IntlOpenOrders.tsx line 71: 'groups' is a dep of useMemo but eslint-disable used — acceptable but flag; groupOf closure captures groups, works because groups memo updates trigger rows memo.
OPEN_POS module-level const is duplicated data source with OPEN_ORDERS in IntlShipmentsPage.tsx (per line 120 OPEN_ORDERS.find). Consider centralising to avoid drift.

In group prefill (IntlShipmentsPage.tsx line 120), SO and PO are joined with ' + ' — verify downstream fields accept multi-value; UI showed no error but may exceed visual field length for large groups.
Number input (is-oo-window) has no aria-label; minor a11y.

Detail 'back' from IS-0011 (invoked before Open Orders test) navigated to a prior route (Feedback) — likely uses history.back rather than route to shipments list; consider explicit /intl-shipments route on back. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Open Orders tab and redesigned priority strip verified end-to-end at iteration 47. If retesting Shipments detail 'back' flow, note history.back may pop to prior sidebar route rather than shipments list.
